name: Vasudev Siddh
headline: AI & Full-Stack Engineer
summary: AI engineer who builds production voice agents and LLM systems, from prototype to tested release. Creator of JustHireMe (2,249★ open source).

bullets: Own agent truthfulness and authorization for a real-time voice AI product: evidence contracts, default-deny access rails, honest failure handling.
Closed cross-tenant and path-traversal vulnerabilities; made raw-error logging impossible at compile time.
Built the streaming voice pipeline and a native macOS (Swift) audio and speaker-identification stack, including a windowed-sinc resampler and on-device Vision OCR.
Governed background execution (leased, recoverable, exactly-once routines) and event-driven preparation; approval-gated CRM write-back.
Run engineering end to end: AI backend, data platform, AWS operations, CI/CD and iOS releases; review and ship the team's work.
Rebuilt the AI assistant: first results 72–122 s → under 10 s; keyword search 10.6 s → 53 ms; ~15–21 ms vector retrieval.
Built the data acquisition and enrichment engine (0% → 99.5% coverage); fixed a notification pipeline failing 100% of deliveries.
